how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: الـreconciliation معناه إنك تثبت إن نظامين متفقين على نفس الحقيقة المالية، وهي الشغلانة اللي بتخلّي كل رقم تاني في الفيديو ده موثوق.
sentences.en: Reconciliation is proving that two systems agree about the same financial truth, and it is the work that makes every other number in this film trustworthy.

sentences.ar: قارن ملف الـswitch بالـcore ledger. سبع سجلات متطابقة.
sentences.en: Compare the switch file against the core ledger. Seven records match.

sentences.ar: وبعدها أربع أنواع مختلفة من الفروق، وهما مش مشكلة واحدة:
sentences.en: Then four different kinds of break, and they are not one problem:

sentences.ar: فرق مبلغ ستة وتلاتين ولاحظ إن ستة وتلاتين بتتقسم على تسعة، وده التوقيع الكلاسيكي لرقمين متبدّلين، يعني دي غلطة إدخال أو parsing، مش غلطة فلوس.
sentences.en: an amount mismatch of thirty-six — and notice thirty-six is divisible by nine, which is the classic signature of two transposed digits, so that is a data-entry or parsing fault, not a money fault.

sentences.ar: وعملية موجودة في الـswitch بس.
sentences.en: One transaction present only in the switch.

sentences.ar: وواحدة موجودة في الـledger بس. وواحدة مكررة.
sentences.en: One present only in the ledger. And one duplicate.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الجملة اللي تاخدها معاك.
sentences.en: Now the sentence to take away.

sentences.ar: الفرق الصافي ستة وستين يورو.
sentences.en: The net difference is sixty-six euros.

sentences.ar: ولو كنت عملت مطابقة على إجمالي صافي واحد، كنت هتشوف فجوة صغيّرة شبه مقبولة لأن تلات أعطال مش مترابطين ألغوا بعض جزئياً.
sentences.en: If you had reconciled on a single net total you would have seen a small, almost acceptable gap — because three unrelated faults partly cancelled each other out.

sentences.ar: الإجمالي الصافي مش reconciliation.
sentences.en: A net total is not a reconciliation.

sentences.ar: المطابقة على مستوى السجل هي الـreconciliation.
sentences.en: Matching at the record level is.

sentences.ar: ونفس الأمانة بتنطبق على الخصوصية.
sentences.en: The same honesty applies to privacy.

sentences.ar: شيل كل معرّف مباشر من الجدول ده وخطر إعادة التعريف لسه واحد تسع صفوف كل واحد فيهم لوحده في فئته.
sentences.en: Remove every direct identifier from this table and re-identification risk is still one — nine rows are each alone in their class.

sentences.ar: عمّم البلد والعقد، وبرضه في صفوف لوحدها.
sentences.en: Generalise country and decade and some rows are still alone.

sentences.ar: والـsuppression بس هي اللي بتوصّلك لمجموعة من اتنين على الأقل.
sentences.en: Only suppression gets you to a group of at least two.

sentences.ar: إخفاء الاسم هو بداية الحماية، مش نهايتها.
sentences.en: Masking a name is where protection starts, not where it ends.

sentences.ar: بعدها طبقة التسليم: acceptance testing بتربط كل بند في الـchecklist بدليل بدل كلمة نجح؛
sentences.en: Then the delivery layer: acceptance testing that ties each checklist item to evidence rather than the word passed;

sentences.ar: وrisk board بيسمّي الأثر والمالك والتخفيف؛
sentences.en: a risk board that names impact, owner and mitigation;

sentences.ar: وdisaster recovery متعبَّر عنه برقمين قد إيه داتا تقدر تخسرها، وقد إيه وقت تقدر تقف فيه.
sentences.en: and disaster recovery expressed as two numbers — how much data you can afford to lose, and how long you can afford to be down.

sentences.ar: عطّل الموقع وقيسهم، لأن خطة استرداد ما اتجربتش هي مستند، مش قدرة.
sentences.en: Fail the site and measure them, because an untested recovery plan is a document, not a capability.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: After loading, comparing source and target counts and totals to prove nothing was lost, d…
concepts.failure: Assuming a green job run means every row arrived, without comparing counts and totals.

concepts.def_en: In privacy, removing or hiding values or rows that would single out an individual, so every remaining group has at least k members.
concepts.def_ar: في الـprivacy، الـsuppression هو حذف أو إخفاء القيم أو الصفوف اللي بتكشف شخص لوحده، فكل مجموعة تفضل فيها k صف على الأقل.
concepts.failure: Removing too few rows leaves unique people; removing too many destroys analytic value.

concepts.def_en: Checking that a delivered system meets the agreed business requirements, with every checklist item tied to evidence rather than the word 'passed'.
concepts.def_ar: التأكد إن النظام المتسلَّم بيحقق متطلبات الشغل المتفق عليها، وكل بند في الـchecklist مربوط بدليل مش بكلمة passed بس.
concepts.failure: Marking items passed without attaching evidence, so nobody can audit what was actually tested.

concepts.def_en: The plan, backups and procedures for restoring systems and data after a major failure, wi…
concepts.failure: Having backups but never testing a restore, so recovery fails when needed.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Two ledgers side by side (source vs target) that reconcile or expose a mismatch.
Events on a track; the cursor moves on anchors.
Rows generalised until each quasi-identifier group has k members.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
